text:
Sanchit: Heads-up — planned RBAC change tonight for private clusters. Removing broad serviceAccount cluster-admin bindings. Need audit + KMS check for secrets decryption fallback. Anyone oncall?
Olivia: thanks. which clusters? dev/staging/prod?
Sanchit: staging + customer-onprem-nyc. Prod is untouched but policy will be same model.
Emma: Is there a known service account that still needs cluster-admin? I saw one binding in audit logs: svcacc-ingest-proxy@infra.
sec-bot: Audit alert — 2026-03-20 22:01Z: removed binding detected in staging. Details: binding id 0xafe3b, principal svcacc-ingest-proxy.
Mike: If we remove binding, will key access still work? KMS decrypt is via node-agent using workload identity.
Jana: node-agent uses Vault transit; we must ensure role->key ACLs are mapped. @platform-infra can you confirm vault policy change?
platform-infra: Confirming: Vault policy maps k8s service account -> role via JWT. If we repoint svcacc name we need jwt audience update. Quick workaround: add a narrowly-scoped role that allows transit/decrypt for ingest proxies only.
Sanchit: Also worried about network isolation: the ingest proxy talks to internal model-serving over 10.81.0.0/16. Removing cluster-admin should not change netpols but double-check.
Olivia: let's gate with a canary: apply RBAC change to staging, then run the decrypt e2e & a quick vuln scan.
Mike: For audit logging — we want all KMS decrypt requests logged to Splunk with request_id and principal. Current pipeline drops some fields. Need to add key_id and principal to telemetry.
Emma: Agreed. Proposed plan:
1) Create narrow Vault role for svcacc-ingest-proxy
2) Deploy RBAC removal on staging 23:00 UTC
3) Run e2e decrypt smoke
4) Run vuln triage (scanner + manual)
5) Promote to prod after 24h
Jana: +1. Also add netpol deny-all egress for the pod and only allow 10.81.0.0/16 to model-serving.
Sanchit: Here's a quick netpol snippet to roll in staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: ingest-proxy-egress-lock
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ingest-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.81.0.0/16
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Olivia: Nice. Add a post-change alert: if any decrypt fails for >5% requests in 5m, rollback.
sec-bot: Incident checklist created: /playbooks/rbac-kms-fallback. Trigger #sec-oncall if rollback needed.
platform-infra: One more: add ephemeral token rotation in node-agent (TTL 5m) to limit exposure if a svcacc escapes.
Mike: Note for forensics: preserve Vault audit logs + KMS audit stream for at least 90 days for on-prem customers per policy.
Sanchit: Rolling at 23:00. @oncall please be available. I'll post status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
oncall: available. ping if anything odd.
Olivia: I'll run the smoke scripts and post results.
